result:
Backend API test stage complete.

## Result: 0 bugs, 0 fixes, 0 commits — backend converged (21st consecutive 0-fix run)

**Drift gate first.** All four vectors are EMPTY at HEAD `ebb1aa1` vs the converged baseline `2d7fb57` (2026-06-19) — source, route files, components/pages, dep/build config. The app source is byte-identical to a baseline already swept 245 routes deep across 20 prior runs, so a full re-sweep would have re-tested unchanged bytes. I ran a live-server health verification of every mount prefix instead.

**Inventory:** 37 route modules, 280 `router.<method>()` declarations, 36 mount prefixes.

**83 requests issued — 0 5xx, 0 unintentional non-200:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Endpoints returning 200 | 60, across every prefix (incl. all 13 `/crm/dashboard/*` widgets, financing, reports, contracts/invoices/work-orders/expenses/subcontractors/territories, alerts, roof-measurement, payments, onboarding, storm-history, disaster-declarations, FEMA housing) |
| Error handling | 10/10 correct |
| Required-param validation | 5/5 correct 400s, all → 200 once the param was supplied |
| Unintentional 5xx | 0 |

Error paths all behave: empty login → 400 with zod details, bad creds → 401, no auth header → 401, `/leads/notanumber` → 400 "Invalid id format" (not 500), `POST /crm/leads {}` → 400 "propertyId is required", unknown route → 404 JSON (not an HTML page). The only intentional non-200 is `1×403` on `/admin/tenants` (platform-admin only).

**The 11 404s I initially hit were my own wrong-path guesses, not bugs** — I traced each one to its real path in the router source and confirmed it returns 200. Two worth recording, now in memory:
- Dashboard widgets live at `/api/crm/dashboard/*` (crm.js). `/api/dashboard/*` has only `stats`, `funnel`, `activity`.
- IDs are UUIDs, so a numeric missing-id like `/crm/leads/999999999` correctly returns 400 "Invalid id format" rather than 404.

**No source was modified** (`git diff -- client/src server/src` empty), so per the charter — which commits only fixes — there was nothing to commit and no build check to run. I left `.qa-token.txt` refreshed on purpose: it's a tracked helper outside the drift gate, and memory notes a stale token there produces ~233 false 401s for later stages. Temp scripts cleaned up.

**Deliverables:** `C:\tmp\api-test-results.txt` (full endpoint table), `overnight_resume.md` and `MEMORY.md` updated for the next run.
